newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-SHEFFIELD SHIELD FINAL CLOSE OF PLAY SCORE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SHEFFIELD SHIELD FINAL CLOSE OF PLAY SCORE.

text.p: Western Australia, replying to Queensland's first innings total of 320, were 164 for nine at the close on the second day of the five-day Sheffield Shield final at the WACA on Saturday.
Scores: Queensland 320 (Matthew Mott 86, Stuart Law 70, Trevor Barsby 67); Western Australia 164 for nine (Murray Goodwin 63; Adam Dale 6-38).
